slides.title: The World Around Us
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 2 English, Unit 7: The World Around Us. In this unit you learn about the world around us — the plants, the trees, the air, and the land and water we all share. You find out how to care for planet Earth by planting, watering, picking up litter and recycling. You learn the parts of a plant and why trees keep our air clean, and you practise saying thank you for the beautiful things in nature. By the end you can make your own promise to care for the Earth, just like Amal in this unit's story, “Amal and the Little Tree”. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name and describe ways to care for the environment, including planting, watering, picking up litter and recycling.
Name the parts of a plant and say what each part does.
Explain why plants and trees are important for clean air.
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name and describe ways to care for the environment, including planting, watering, picking up litter and recycling. You will also name the parts of a plant and say what each part does. You will also explain why plants and trees are important for clean air. Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: boat, coat, soap, snow, grow, show. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Mother Earth Day and Plants and Clean Air. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Present Continuous: Actions Happening Now
bullets: We use the present continuous to say what is happening right now. In this unit it lets you describe what people are doing to help the Earth, such as...
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Present Continuous: Actions Happening Now. We use the present continuous to say what is happening right now. In this unit it lets you describe what people are doing to help the Earth, such as planting, watering or picking up litter. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 — Talk About Environmental Actions. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
